lines.en: label halloweentwo1:
scene secondhalloweenintro1
Well, it’s the end of my day and I’m alone in my office...which probably means something interesting is about to happen.
lines.zh: 嗯，一天结束了，我一个人在办公室里……这大概意味着马上要发生点有意思的事了。

lines.en: Sure, there have been plenty of days where that hasn’t been the case, but since I’ve already begun inner-monologuing, I think it’s safe to assume today isn’t one of those days.
lines.zh: 当然，也有很多天并不是这样，不过既然我已经开始内心独白了，我想可以安全地假定今天不是那种日子。

lines.en: The only question now is {i}who{/i} is going to show up and {i}what{/i} they’re going to want from me.
lines.zh: 现在唯一的问题是，{i}谁{/i}会来，以及她们想从我这儿要{i}什么{/i}。

lines.en: The beach trip is over and done with. Some hearts have been broken (One, to be specific) and others renewed. (Again- one, to be specific.)
lines.zh: 海边之行已经结束。有些心碎了（具体来说，一颗），有些则重新焕发了（同样，具体来说，一颗）。

lines.en: I’ve even partially fixed my connection with my idol ex-girlfriend who, unbeknownst to her hordes of raging fans, is actually a shirt-stealing, half-nerdy pervert who excels at tongue wrestling.
lines.zh: 我甚至部分修复了和我那位偶像前女友之间的关系——在她那群暴怒的粉丝所不知道的另一面，她其实是个会偷衬衫、半吊子书呆子的变态，还擅长舌吻。

lines.en: In fact, now that I think about it, I could probably quit teaching and publish a wordy exposé about her and just live off the money that makes for the rest of my life.
lines.zh: 事实上，现在想想，我大概可以干脆不当老师，写一篇关于她的冗长爆料文，然后靠那笔钱过完余生。

lines.en: But, then again, that would negatively impact the probability of me having sex with her in the future, so it might not be the best idea.
lines.zh: 不过话说回来，那会降低我将来和她上床的概率，所以这可能不是个好主意。

lines.en: {i}Unless I can think of a pseudonym.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}除非我能想出一个笔名。{/i}

lines.en: : Um...Sensei? Are you...free right now?
lines.zh: : 那个……Sensei？你现在……有空吗？

lines.en: : Hm? Oh. Yeah.
lines.zh: : 嗯？哦。有啊。

lines.en: : Come on in, Sana.
lines.zh: : 进来吧，Sana。

lines.en: scene secondhalloweenintro2
: Sorry for the sudden intrusion...
lines.zh: : 抱歉突然打扰……

lines.en: : It’s fine. I was just trying to think up a pseudonym to use for an upcoming takedown article of a beloved public figure.
lines.zh: : 没事。我刚才只是在想一个笔名，准备写一篇即将发表的、针对某位受人爱戴的公众人物的爆料文。

lines.en: : Do you have any ideas?
lines.zh: : 你有什么想法吗？

lines.en: scene secondhalloweenintro3
: You’re...going to take someone down?
lines.zh: : 你……要去搞垮一个人？

lines.en: : Maybe. I was going to put a little more thought into it, but it appears the time has come to get roped into yet another fun misadventure with you and...whoever else is involved.
lines.zh: : 也许吧。我本来想再多考虑一下的，不过看来是时候又被你，还有……其他相关人士，卷进新一轮的有趣冒险里了。

lines.en: : Misadventure?
lines.zh: : 冒险？

lines.en: : That’s why you’re here, isn’t it? To tell me about some sort of special event that will proceed to consume the rest of my day- possibly even more?
lines.zh: : 你来不就是为了这个吗？告诉我某个特别活动，然后它会吞掉我今天剩下的时间——说不定还不止？

lines.en: scene secondhalloweenintro4
: I’m...actually here to remind you about tonight’s Halloween party at Ayane’s house...
lines.zh: : 我……其实是来提醒你今晚在天宫家举办的万圣节派对的……

lines.en: I look down at my phone to confirm the date and it appears that my hunch was spot on.
lines.zh: 我低头看了眼手机确认日期，看来我的直觉完全正确。

lines.en: It only makes sense that the Halloween party would be today considering...well, the fact that it’s Halloween.
lines.zh: 万圣节派对就在今天，这理所当然——考虑到……嗯，今天就是万圣节。

lines.en: But I’m not really one to keep track of specific dates.
lines.zh: 但我本来就不是会记具体日期的人。

lines.en: To me, life is just a series of the same seven days over and over and over again, and it’s up to everyone else to remind me of which days are decidedly more significant than others.
lines.zh: 对我来说，生活不过是同样七天一遍又一遍地重复，至于哪天比别的日子更重要，全靠别人提醒。

lines.en: It’s strange that Sana had to be the one to tell me about it, though. Normally, this would be a job for Ami or Ayane or something.
lines.zh: 不过奇怪的是，居然是Sana来告诉我。按理说，这种事该由Ami或者Ayane之类的来做。

lines.en: : Well, your reminder has been received. Now what?
lines.zh: : 好，你的提醒我收到了。然后呢？

lines.en: scene secondhalloweenintro5
: I think...now, I’m supposed to take you over to the manga club...
lines.zh: : 我觉得……现在，我该带你去漫画社……

lines.en: : Ahh, yes. What better person to take me to the manga club than someone who is not in the manga club?
lines.zh: : 啊，是啊。带我去漫画社，还有比一个根本不在漫画社的人更合适的吗？

lines.en: : Well...I would normally agree, but...all of the other girls are already in their costumes and...didn’t want to walk through the halls like that...
lines.zh: : 嗯……我平时也会同意的，可是……其他女孩都已经换好变装服了，而且……不想穿着那样穿过走廊……

lines.en: : And...they needed your help deciding which one...looks the nicest.
lines.zh: : 还有……她们需要你帮忙决定哪一套……最好看。

lines.en: : Ahh. Well, yes. That is certainly a job only {i}I{/i} can do.
lines.zh: : 啊。好吧。这确实是非{i}我{/i}不可的工作。

lines.en: : Why aren’t you dressed up, though? Don’t you want to be in this contest too?
lines.zh: : 不过你怎么没打扮？你不想也参加这个比赛吗？

lines.en: if sanafashion == True:
: I already have a proven history of choosing you to win fashion shows, so...
lines.zh: : 我可是有前科的，在时装秀上选你赢，所以……

lines.en: scene secondhalloweenintro6
: N-No! That’s...okay...
lines.zh: : 不、不用了！那……没关系……

lines.en: : I don’t...even know what I’m going to be yet...
lines.zh: : 我连……自己要扮什么都还不知道……

lines.en: : What? The party is tonight, though, isn’t it?
lines.zh: : 什么？派对不是今晚吗？

lines.en: : I...figured I’d just...go through some of my mom’s old clothes and stuff...
lines.zh: : 我……想着就……翻翻我妈的旧衣服什么的……

lines.en: : I’m...not very good at choosing Halloween costumes...
lines.zh: : 我……不太擅长挑万圣节变装服……

lines.en: : But the sex dolphin was great.
lines.zh: : 可那只性感海豚就很棒啊。

lines.en: scene secondhalloweenintro7
: I-It wasn’t a sex dolphin!
lines.zh: : 那、那才不是性感海豚！

lines.en: : S-S-Sex dolphins aren’t even real!
lines.zh: : 性、性、性感海豚根本就不存在！

lines.en: : Tell that to Sexy Land, Sana.
lines.zh: : 这话你去跟性感乐园说吧，Sana。

lines.en: scene secondhalloweenintro8
: I’m...still trying to forget about Sexy Land...
lines.zh: : 我……还在努力忘掉性感乐园的事……

lines.en: scene black
I get off of my chair, accepting that I likely won’t have to actually {i}counsel{/i} anyone today on account of the whole party thing, and let Sana lead the way out.
lines.zh: 我从椅子上起身——考虑到派对这档子事，我今天大概是不用真的给人做{i}咨询{/i}了——然后让Sana带路出去。

lines.en: I think along the way that it’s strange how I’m letting her lead {i}anything{/i}, but I guess with how much she’s been growing lately, it only makes sense.
lines.zh: 一路上我觉得，{i}让她带路{/i}这件事本身就很奇怪，不过念在她最近成长了不少，倒也说得通。

lines.en: I mean, it’s not like she’s pushing me up against the lockers and grabbing my crotch. She’s literally just walking me down the hall.
lines.zh: 我是说，她又没把我按在储物柜上抓我的要害。她真的只是陪我走过走廊而已。

lines.en: But even that much is a big deal for her when she could barely even hold a conversation with me back at the start of everything.
lines.zh: 但即便如此，对她来说也算得上是件大事了——毕竟一开始她连跟我正常说话都费劲。

lines.en: : Sensei? You’ve been quiet...
lines.zh: : Sensei？你一直不说话……

lines.en: : Sorry. Just getting nostalgic.
lines.zh: : 抱歉。只是有些感慨。

lines.en: : I’m proud of you, Sana.
lines.zh: : 我为你骄傲，Sana。

lines.en: : Uhh...for...what, exactly?
lines.zh: : 呃……具体是……为什么？

lines.en: : Nothing. I’m ready to be pushed up against the lockers whenever you are.
lines.zh: : 没什么。你什么时候想把我按在储物柜上，我都准备好了。

lines.en: : Oh...uhh...
: What?...
scene secondhalloweenintro9
I make my way into the manga club room to be immediately swarmed by a group of[school] girls in spandex.
lines.zh: 我走进漫画社活动室，立刻被一群穿着氨纶的[school]女生围住了。

lines.en: Nice.
lines.zh: 不错。

lines.en: Sana, not wanting to be involved in this at all apart from her assistance in guiding me here, takes a seat in the corner of the room and begins playing some sort of game on her phone.
lines.zh: Sana除了负责把我领到这儿，完全不想掺和进来，于是她坐到房间角落，开始玩手机上的什么游戏。

lines.en: : Why hello, traveler. I see that fate hath been kind enough to coordinate this ever-welcome crossing of our paths.
lines.zh: : 你好啊，旅人。看来命运仁慈地安排了我们这次备受欢迎的邂逅。

lines.en: : Hi, Molly. And hello to everyone who is actually human.
lines.zh: : 嗨，Molly。还有，人类同胞们，你们好。

lines.en: : What great costumes that I am definitely just seeing now for the first time.
lines.zh: : 多棒的变装服啊，我绝对是这辈子第一次见到。

lines.en: : That...makes it sound like you’ve somehow seen them before?...
lines.zh: : 那……听起来像是你以前见过似的？……

lines.en: : Impossible, for this wanderer has not only no vision, but no {i}sight{/i} as well.
lines.zh: : 不可能，因为这位漫游者不仅没有视力，也没有{i}视觉{/i}。

lines.en: : Are those...not the same thing?
lines.zh: : 那不是……同一个东西吗？

lines.en: scene secondhalloweenintro10
: Nay, traveler. Sight is a power granted to only those worthy of bearing the Auge der Verurteilung.
lines.zh: : 非也，旅人。视觉是只赐予那些有资格持有“审判之眼”之人的力量。

lines.en: : ‘Tis such a blessing that allows me, the Prinzessin der Verurteilung, to protect thee from harm as you tread lightly throughout this realm and dominion!
lines.zh: : 正是这份恩赐，让我——审判公主——得以保护你在这片疆域中轻步前行时免受伤害！

lines.en: : Cool.
: Sana told you about the party, right?
lines.zh: : Sana告诉你派对的事了吧？

lines.en: : Yeah. And I want to say it came out of nowhere, but that’s probably on me and not something I can really hold against any of you.
lines.zh: : 嗯。虽然我想说这来得太突然了，但这大概怪我自己，不能怪你们任何人。

lines.en: : Sensei! Aren’t you glad I decided to wear something that isn’t a full suit of armor this year?
lines.zh: : Sensei！今年我决定不穿一整套盔甲了，你是不是很开心？

lines.en: : As much as I liked my last costume, I wound up feeling really lonely when you were looking at everyone other than me all night.
lines.zh: : 虽然我很喜欢去年的变装服，但结果你整晚都在看别人、就是不看我，我觉得好寂寞。

lines.en: scene secondhalloweenintro11
: Hey, Ayane. Remember that “joke” I made about how letting you dress up as Lumine should mean that you have to keep your mouth shut for the entire night?
lines.zh: : 嘿，Ayane。还记得我开的那个“玩笑”吗？我说让你扮成荧，就代表你得整晚闭嘴。

lines.en: : Yup! It was hilarious, Ami. Especially because I know you love me and would {i}never{/i} want me to keep my mouth shut for that long.
lines.zh: : 记得！真好笑啊，Ami。尤其是因为我知道你爱我，{i}绝对不会{/i}想让我闭嘴那么久。

lines.en: : Are you sure about that?
lines.zh: : 你确定？

lines.en: : Sup, homie! You confused walking into a room with a bunch of girls dressed in weird fantasy costume things?
lines.zh: : 哟，老兄！走进一间全是穿奇怪奇幻变装服女生的屋子，是不是有点懵？

lines.en: if rinbetrayed == True:
: I'm more confused about why you're suddenly back to-
lines.zh: : 我更懵的是你怎么突然又回到——

lines.en: : Dressing up? Why, because it's Halloween, of course!
lines.zh: : 打扮起来？那还用说，因为今天是万圣节啊！

lines.en: : I mean...I'm not against it. I just figured you might be sitting this one out on account of-
lines.zh: : 我意思是……我不反对。我只是以为你这次会缺席，因为——

lines.en: : Getting too old for this sort of thing? Nope! Still fun!
lines.zh: : 因为年纪太大玩不动这种了？才不是！还是很好玩！

lines.en: : Everything's totally normal and I have no idea what you're talking about.
lines.zh: : 一切完全正常，我不知道你在说什么。

lines.en: Well...I guess Rin is better now?
lines.zh: 嗯……看来Rin是没事了？

lines.en: : Um...anyway...I think Molly wanted to get your thoughts on how all of us look since...she’s the one who made all of the adjustments to our outfits.
lines.zh: : 那个……总之……我觉得Molly想听听你对我们所有人造型的看法，因为……是她帮我们改的衣服。

lines.en: else:
: Yes. But that doesn’t mean I’m any less excited to be here.
lines.zh: : 好。不过这并不妨碍我来这儿的兴奋程度。

lines.en: : I think...Molly wanted to get your thoughts on how all of us look since...she’s the one who made all of the adjustments to our outfits.
lines.zh: : 我觉得……Molly想听听你对我们所有人造型的看法，因为……是她帮我们改的衣服。

lines.en: : Just the adjustments? She didn’t make the whole costumes this time?
lines.zh: : 只是改？这次她没做整件衣服？

lines.en: scene secondhalloweenintro12
: Just who do you think I am, Sir? Even someone as adept with a sewing machine as I could not hope to accomplish such a task without an extraordinary amount of both supplies and time.
lines.zh: : 您把我当成什么人了，先生？就算是我这种缝纫机使得很溜的人，没有大量的材料和时间，也别想完成那种任务。

lines.en: : Well, it certainly seemed like you had enough time to memorize all of those weird German sounding words.
lines.zh: : 好吧，不过看样子你倒是有足够的时间去背下那些听起来像德语的怪词。

lines.en: : Fair point. I accept defeat and will work harder in the future.
lines.zh: : 有道理。我认输，今后会更加努力。

lines.en: : Sensei, you’re coming to the party again this year, right?
lines.zh: : Sensei，你今年也会来派对吧？

lines.en: : Of course. Why wouldn’t I?
lines.zh: : 当然。我为什么不来？

lines.en: : I don’t know man. Didn’t you just find out about it? What if you, like...have other friends now?
lines.zh: : 我不知道啊，老兄。你不是刚知道这事吗？万一你，比如……现在有别的朋友了呢？

lines.en: : Sensei doesn’t need other friends when he has us.
lines.zh: : Sensei有我们就够了，不需要别的朋友。

lines.en: : As you can see, Rin, my [niece] won’t let me do anything else.
lines.zh: : 如你所见，Rin，我的[niece]不让我有别的选择。

lines.en: : Well, um...we’re happy to have you again...
lines.zh: : 嗯，那个……我们也很高兴你能来……

lines.en: : So if you...wanted to leave the room {i}without{/i} choosing which one of us is the cutest...I’m sure that would be fine...
lines.zh: : 所以如果你……想直接走出这个房间，{i}不{/i}选我们当中谁最可爱……我想那也没关系的……

lines.en: scene secondhalloweenintro13
: Dude, just do the thing I told you and you’ll win for sure.
lines.zh: : 老兄，就照我跟你说的那个做，你肯定赢。

lines.en: : I...don’t know about that, Rin...
lines.zh: : 我……不太确定啊，Rin……

lines.en: : Sensei, I {i}do{/i} hope you know that you’re not porting out of this realm until you choose a winner.
lines.zh: : Sensei，我得提醒你，在选出赢家之前，你{i}是{/i}走不出这片疆域的。

lines.en: : As much as I’d love to, aren’t you guys missing someone?
lines.zh: : 虽然我也很想，但你们是不是少了一个人？

lines.en: : I remember there being a sixth person in the picture that I {i}totally did not see{/i}.
lines.zh: : 我记得照片里应该有第六个人，而我{i}绝对没有看到过{/i}。

lines.en: : Well that’s certainly not suspicious or anything.
lines.zh: : 嗯，这一点也不可疑呢。

lines.en: : I believe Sensei wholeheartedly because I love him and he would never lie.
lines.zh: : 我全心全意相信Sensei，因为我爱他，而他绝不会撒谎。

lines.en: : Sir, if you are referring to Maya, she is hiding in the corner of the room.
lines.zh: : 先生，如果你指的是Maya，她躲在房间的角落里。

lines.en: : Ugh. Great.
lines.zh: : 呃。好极了。

lines.en: scene secondhalloweenintro14
: Well, hello there.
lines.zh: : 你好啊。

lines.en: : Are you attempting to sound predatory on purpose or is that just a convenient coincidence?
lines.zh: : 你是故意想听起来像个捕食者，还是这只是个凑巧的巧合？

lines.en: : A little of both, probably.
lines.zh: : 大概两者都有吧。

lines.en: : You’re cute when you’re not dressing up as me for Halloween.
lines.zh: : 你不扮成我的时候，还挺可爱的。

lines.en: : I’m aware. I don’t need you to remind me of this.
lines.zh: : 我知道。不需要你提醒。

lines.en: : That’s fine. But I’m going to remind you anyway and no one can get mad at me because that is the actual purpose I was brought to this room for.
lines.zh: : 没关系。不过我还是要提醒你，而且没人能生我的气，因为这就是把我带到这个房间的真正目的。

lines.en: : Hooray.
lines.zh: : 好棒哦。

lines.en: : Okay! So, to prevent Sensei from flirting with Maya anymore, how about we finally get to our contest thingy?!
lines.zh: : 好了！为了防止Sensei再跟Maya调情，我们赶紧开始比赛吧！？

lines.en: scene secondhalloweenintro9
: Fine by me.
lines.zh: : 我没意见。

lines.en: : Is there anything I have to know about judging or am I literally just picking the person I think looks the best?
lines.zh: : 评审有什么规矩吗，还是说我真的就只是选我觉得最好看的人？

lines.en: : Just whoever you think looks the best, Sir.
lines.zh: : 就选您觉得最好看的那个，先生。

lines.en: : Choices like this are a staple in h-games and can typically have much bigger consequences than you’d expect!
lines.zh: : 这种选择在 H game 里是基本操作，而且后果往往比你想象的严重得多！

lines.en: : Or no consequences at all! The fun is in not knowing if what you did was right or wrong until it’s too late to change anything!
lines.zh: : 也可能一点后果都没有！乐趣就在于你永远不知道自己做得对不对，等到发现时已经来不及改了！

lines.en: : So basically, what you’re saying is that the pressure is on.
lines.zh: : 所以你们的意思是，压力在我身上。

lines.en: : Exactly, Sir. But don’t fret!
lines.zh: : 正是，先生。不过别怕！

lines.en: : I’ll love you no matter who you pick, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 不管你选谁我都会爱你的，Sensei。

lines.en: : So will I. But you better pick me anyway.
lines.zh: : 我也是。不过你最好还是选我。

lines.en: : I vote for Futaba because boobs.
lines.zh: : 我投Futaba，因为胸。

lines.en: : I’ll...vote for Rin because she voted for me.
lines.zh: : 我……投Rin，因为她投了我。

lines.en: scene secondhalloweenintro15
: Sana! Lights, please!
lines.zh: : Sana！灯光，拜托！

lines.en: : What? I...have a job?...
lines.zh: : 什么？我……还有工作？……

lines.en: : Of course! We need the room lights to go off before turning the spotlight on to make us all look cooler and more...awesome and stuff.
lines.zh: : 当然！我们需要先把房间的灯关掉，再打开聚光灯，好让我们所有人看起来更酷、更……有范儿什么的。

lines.en: : But...I don’t even know where-
lines.zh: : 可是……我连在哪儿都不——

lines.en: : Wait...is this it?
lines.zh: : 等等……是这个吗？

lines.en: scene secondhalloweenintro16
: No. That’s the red accent light. It turns down all of the other colors and just makes the reds more visible and stuff.
lines.zh: : 不是。那是红色补光。它会压暗其他所有颜色，只让红色更显眼什么的。

lines.en: : I accept this light.
lines.zh: : 我接受这盏灯。

lines.en: : It’s the one right next to that one, Sana.
lines.zh: : 是紧挨着那盏的那盏，Sana。

lines.en: : The one right...oh! This!
lines.zh: : 紧挨着的……哦！这个！

lines.en: scene secondhalloweenintro17
: Yeah! There we go!
lines.zh: : 对！就是这个！

lines.en: : Places, everyone!
lines.zh: : 各就各位，大家！

lines.en: scene black
The girls begin to line up in single file fashion as if this is something they’ve already rehearsed.
lines.zh: 女孩们开始排成一列纵队，仿佛她们早就排练过似的。

lines.en: Which, now that I think about it, isn’t really something I’d put past them if Ami, Ayane, and Molly are involved.
lines.zh: 现在想想，如果有Ami、Ayane和Molly参与，这种事我还真不觉得她们干不出来。

lines.en: Which isn’t to say that Molly puts me on the same pedestal as the other two. But she seems to like large scale contests like this.
lines.zh: 这倒不是说Molly把我跟另外两位放在同一座神坛上。但她似乎喜欢这种大规模的比赛。

lines.en: And the validation she’ll receive in knowing how attracted I am to all of the costumes she assisted in tailoring (To an unknown extent) may offset some of her newfound misery.
lines.zh: 而知道我对她参与剪裁（程度不明）的所有变装服有多心动，这份认可或许能抵消她新近的一部分苦闷。

lines.en: But hey, I don’t really have the time to be caring about the sadness of others right now when I have an entire room of [teenager]s seeking validation.
lines.zh: 不过话说回来，我现在可没空去关心别人的悲伤，毕竟屋里有一整间[teenager]在等着我给出认可。

lines.en: Let the contest commence.
lines.zh: 比赛开始。

lines.en: scene secondhalloweenintro18
: First up is Sensei’s very own [niece] and the first thing he sees every morning, Ami Arakawa- cosplaying the fiery, yet lovable...Outrider Amber of the Knights of Favonius!
lines.zh: : 第一位登场的是Sensei自己的[niece]、他每天清晨第一眼看到的人——荒川Ami，cosplay 的是热情又讨人喜欢的……西风骑士团的侦察骑士安柏！

lines.en: : Um...okay, it feels kind of weird being judged like this now. This is nothing like the rehearsals at all.
lines.zh: : 嗯……好吧，被人这么评判感觉怪怪的。这跟排练的时候完全不一样。

lines.en: : Nonsense, Ami! Just do what you do best and stand there absorbing your [uncle]’s lascivious gaze!
lines.zh: : 胡说，Ami！你只要做你最擅长的事就好——站在那儿，承受你[uncle]那色眯眯的注视！

lines.en: : You’re disgusting.
lines.zh: : 你真恶心。

lines.en: : Me or Molly? Because I didn’t do anything.
lines.zh: : 我还是Molly？我可什么都没做。

lines.en: : Both of you.
lines.zh: : 你们两个。

lines.en: scene secondhalloweenintro19
: Next up is the lovely and humble astrologist Mona Megistus, cosplayed by Maya Makinami! So many M’s!
lines.zh: : 下一位是可爱又谦逊的占星术士莫娜·梅姬斯图斯，由牧菜Maya扮演！M 也太多了！

lines.en: : Astrologist?
lines.zh: : 占星术士？

lines.en: : Don’t misconstrue this as me believing in astrology. Frankly, I think it’s a big joke and think even the term “pseudoscience” is too kind in describing it.
lines.zh: : 别误以为我相信占星术。坦白说，我觉得那是个大笑话，就连“伪科学”这个词用来形容它都太客气了。

lines.en: : However, astrology functions differently in the game than it does in real life and I see the character as just some other girl with nice legs who also likes stars.
lines.zh: : 不过，游戏里的占星术跟现实中的运作方式不同，我把这个角色就当成另一个腿很好看、也喜欢星星的普通女孩。

lines.en: : Well, it looks really good on you.
lines.zh: : 嗯，你穿这身很好看。

lines.en: : Thanks. Now, please look at Ayane instead and continue ignoring that I was ever even here.
lines.zh: : 谢了。现在请去看Ayane吧，继续当我不曾在这里出现过。

lines.en: scene secondhalloweenintro20
: Moving things right along and complying with Maya’s demands, here comes Ayane Amamiya as our very own main character, Lumine!
lines.zh: : 我们加快进度，遵从Maya的要求，接下来是天宫Ayane，扮演我们本作的主角——荧！

lines.en: : Banished to years of only being viewed as a lovable, backseat love interest while Ami sits up in the front, it is Ayane’s mission to have Sensei make {i}her{/i} into the main heroine this time.
lines.zh: : 被贬为常年只能当个讨喜的后排恋爱对象，而Ami却坐在前排，Ayane这次的任务，是让Sensei把{i}她{/i}变成女主角。

lines.en: : Please also note that I did not write that description and it was handed to me on an index card prior to Ayane taking the stage.
lines.zh: : 另外请注意，这段描述不是我写的，是Ayane上台前写在索引卡上交给我念的。

lines.en: : You’re not a “backseat” character, Ayane...
lines.zh: : 你才不是“后排”角色呢，Ayane……

lines.en: scene secondhalloweenintro21
: I {i}can{/i} be if you want me to.
lines.zh: : 你想让我是的话，我{i}就是{/i}。

lines.en: : Ooh! What brilliant and flirtatious execution! That’s our bubblewrap princess for you!
lines.zh: : 哦！多么精彩又撩人的临场发挥！不愧是我们的泡泡纸公主！

lines.en: scene secondhalloweenintro22
: Up next we have Ganyu of the Liyue Qixing and- what’s this?! Is Futaba BUSTing out of the gate by accentuating her most deadly asset?
lines.zh: : 接下来是璃月七星之一的甘雨，而——这是什么？！Futaba难道要冲出起跑线，突出她最致命的武器吗？

lines.en: : Atta girl, Futaba! Knock him dead!
lines.zh: : 好样的，Futaba！迷死他！

lines.en: : Just not literally because then we’d be murderers and {i}I can’t go down that path again...{/i}
lines.zh: : 当然不是字面意义上的迷死，不然我们就成杀人犯了，{i}我可不能再走那条路了{/i}……

lines.en: : Are you sure you’re in [high_school], Futaba?
lines.zh: : 你确定自己还在上[high_school]吗，Futaba？

lines.en: : I don’t...really want to talk right now...
lines.zh: : 我……现在不太想说话……

lines.en: : I’m...too embarrassed for listening to Rin’s idea.
lines.zh: : 听了Rin的主意，我太害臊了。

lines.en: : Well...it is definitely working.
lines.zh: : 嗯……不过那招确实很有效。

lines.en: : A harsh but realistic admittal from our protagonist!
lines.zh: : 来自我们主角的严厉又现实的坦白！

lines.en: : But with a few girls left to take the stage, this is still anyone’s game!
lines.zh: : 不过还有几位姑娘没登场，胜负仍未可知！

lines.en: scene secondhalloweenintro23
: Which...brings us to Jean.
lines.zh: : 那么……有请琴。

lines.en: : Can someone else announce this part? My throat suddenly hurts.
lines.zh: : 这段能换个人来报吗？我嗓子突然疼。

lines.en: : So, how ‘bout Futaba’s boobs. Right?
lines.zh: : 那么，Futaba的胸怎么样。对吧？

lines.en: : I mean...I wouldn’t go discounting your outfit just because Futaba looked great.
lines.zh: : 我意思是……我不会因为Futaba好看就低估你那身衣服。

lines.en: : You’re really cute as well.
lines.zh: : 你也很可爱啊。

lines.en: : Yeaaaaah, but I’m also off limits. And Otoha might get jealous if you call me cute and stuff.
lines.zh: : 是————啊，可我是禁区啊。而且你要是夸我可爱什么的，Otoha可能会吃醋。

lines.en: : Otoha isn’t even here.
lines.zh: : Otoha又不在这儿。

lines.en: : Otoha is always here in spirit.
lines.zh: : Otoha在精神上永远都在。

lines.en: : Is she dead now?
lines.zh: : 她现在死了吗？

lines.en: : Would I be smiling if she was?
lines.zh: : 如果她死了，我还会笑吗？

lines.en: : Not unless...
lines.zh: : 除非……

lines.en: : {i}You killed her...{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}是你杀了她……{/i}

lines.en: scene secondhalloweenintro24
: You know too much...
lines.zh: : 你知道得太多了……

lines.en: scene secondhalloweenintro25
: W-What’s this?! A last minute entry?!
lines.zh: : 什、什么？！最后关头还有人报名？！

lines.en: : I was just...going to get my bag...
lines.zh: : 我只是……想去拿我的包……

lines.en: : I didn’t mean to get in the way...
lines.zh: : 我不是故意挡路的……

lines.en: : Too bad! Because now you’re an official contestant in the Halloween pre-game fashion show!
lines.zh: : 可惜！因为你现在正式成为万圣节赛前时装秀的参赛者了！

lines.en: : Good luck, Sana.
lines.zh: : 祝你好运，Sana。

lines.en: scene secondhalloweenintro26
: I’m not even supposed to be up here!
lines.zh: : 我本来就不该站在这上面的！

lines.en: scene secondhalloweenintro27
: And last but not least is I...Fischl von Luftschloss Narfidort, Prinzessin der Verurteilung...
lines.zh: : 最后但同样重要的是我……菲谢尔·冯·卢夫施洛斯·纳菲多特，审判公主……

lines.en: : ...What?
scene secondhalloweenintro28
: Molly MacCormack as another girl with chuunibyou syndrome. Cute, right?
lines.zh: : Molly·麦科马克，扮演又一个患有中二病的女孩。很可爱吧？

lines.en: : I have no idea what anything you just said means.
lines.zh: : 我完全不知道你刚才说的是什么意思。

lines.en: : Then it looks like it’s time for another weebnote!
lines.zh: : 那看来是时候再来一条宅知识注解了！

lines.en: : Chuunibyou syndrome is the name for the delusional outlook shared by many [adolescent]s in which they create and live in false realities to help cope with insecurities or escape growing up!
lines.zh: : 中二病指的是许多[adolescent]共有的一种妄想心态，他们会创造并生活在虚假的现实里，以此来应对不安或逃避成长！

lines.en: : It’s typically a short-lived phase, but can sometimes spiral out of control and carry on for much greater lengths of time, turning otherwise lovable characters into socially awkward nightmares!
lines.zh: : 这通常是个短暂的阶段，但有时会失控，持续非常长的时间，把原本讨人喜欢的角色变成社交方面的噩梦！

lines.en: : That sounds extremely familiar.
lines.zh: : 这听起来熟悉得过分了。

lines.en: : You’re telling me, Sir!
lines.zh: : 可不是嘛，先生！

lines.en: scene secondhalloweenintro29
: So, which one of us is it going to be?!
lines.zh: : 那么，你会选我们当中的谁呢？！

lines.en: : Remember! This is an important decision that may or may not influence your future with whichever girl you choose!
lines.zh: : 记住！这是个重要的决定，可能会、也可能不会影响你和所选女孩的未来！

lines.en: : Or not! Again, you’ll never know until it’s too late.
lines.zh: : 也可能不会！再说一次，等到发现时为时已晚。

lines.en: : This somehow feels a lot heavier than the dorm war fashion show. I don’t know if I’m ready.
lines.zh: : 这感觉比宿舍大战那次时装秀沉重多了。我不知道自己准备好了没有。

lines.en: : When in doubt, pick Ami. That’s my philosophy.
lines.zh: : 拿不准就选Ami。这是我的处世哲学。

lines.en: : What a weird way to say “Choose Ayane because she’ll let you do stuff in the backseat.”
lines.zh: : “选Ayane吧，因为她会让你在后座上为所欲为”，这说法可真怪。

lines.en: : I...still think Rin looks the best.
lines.zh: : 我……还是觉得Rin最好看。

lines.en: : Counterpoint: Boobs.
lines.zh: : 反驳：胸。

lines.en: : Go on, Sir! Choose!
lines.zh: : 来吧，先生！选吧！

lines.en: menu:
Ami
lines.zh: Ami

lines.en: : I’m going to go ahead and give this victory to Ami.
lines.zh: : 我要宣布，这次的赢家是Ami。

lines.en: scene secondhalloweenintro30
: Ah!! Really?!
lines.zh: : 啊！！真的吗？！

lines.en: : I really won?!
lines.zh: : 我真的赢了？！

lines.en: : You think I’m prettier than everyone else in the room?! And that you’ll stay with me forever and ever no matter what?!
lines.zh: : 你觉得我比屋里所有人都漂亮？！而且不管发生什么你都会永远跟我在一起？！

lines.en: : I was more or less just choosing your costume, but sure. That doesn’t sound so bad.
lines.zh: : 我大体上只是在选你的变装服，不过行啊。听起来也不赖。

lines.en: scene secondhalloweenintro31
: Congratulations, Ami. I still wish Sensei picked me, but I respect his decision.
lines.zh: : 恭喜你，Ami。虽然我还是希望Sensei选我，但我尊重他的决定。

lines.en: : If you were {i}my{/i} [niece], I’d treasure you dearly.
lines.zh: : 如果你是{i}我的{/i}[niece]，我会把你当珍宝一样疼的。

lines.en: : I’m so happy...I don’t even know what to say!
lines.zh: : 我好开心……我都不知道该说什么了！

lines.en: : Thank you!
lines.zh: : 谢谢你！

lines.en: : Thank you, thank you, thank you!
lines.zh: : 谢谢你，谢谢你，谢谢你！

lines.en: : And...And I love you!
lines.zh: : 还有……还有我爱你！

lines.en: : Yeah!
: You don’t have to thank me. Just...doing my best as an impartial judge.
lines.zh: : 你不用谢我。我只是……尽一个公正评审的本分。

lines.en: : Are you sure you’re being impartial? And that you’re not just choosing me because I make your bed and cook you breakfast and wake you up and warm the bath for you and-
lines.zh: : 你确定你公正吗？你不是因为我可以给你铺床、做早餐、叫你起床、帮你放洗澡水才选我的吗，还有——

lines.en: : Yes, you do a lot of things for me. Everyone knows that.
lines.zh: : 是啊，你为我做了很多事。这谁都知道。

lines.en: : Now, accept your victory and stop making the other girls jealous. This was hard enough {i}without{/i} any of you trying to kill each other.
lines.zh: : 现在，接受你的胜利吧，别再让其他女孩嫉妒了。就算你们{i}不{/i}互相残杀，这已经够难了。

: Ahhhhh! Sensei!
lines.zh: : 啊啊啊啊！Sensei！

lines.en: : Is it because of the backseat stuff?! I can have a limo here in five minutes!
lines.zh: : 是因为后座那件事吗？！我五分钟内就能叫一辆加长轿车来！

lines.en: : It’s because I think you look the best. No ulterior motives involved.
lines.zh: : 是因为我觉得你最好看。没有任何别的目的。

lines.en: : Are you sure? Because I could probably even make it {i}four{/i} minutes if I ask nicely enough.
lines.zh: : 你确定吗？因为如果我好好求一求，说不定能缩短到{i}四{/i}分钟。

lines.en: : I thought for sure you were going to pick me...
lines.zh: : 我还以为你肯定会选我呢……

lines.en: : Well, Ami...that’s because you’re delusional and {i}always{/i} expect me to pick you.
lines.zh: : 嗯，Ami……那是因为你是妄想狂，{i}总{/i}觉得我会选你。

lines.en: : Yeah, so?
lines.zh: : 是啊，那又怎样？

lines.en: : I just think Ayane deserves this one.
lines.zh: : 我只是觉得这次该轮到Ayane了。

lines.en: scene secondhalloweenintro33
: Mmmmmmmmm! I wanna scream! But then somebody would probably barge into the room and see you with a bunch of girls in costume and get you fired.
lines.zh: : 嗯嗯嗯嗯嗯！我想尖叫！但那样大概会有人冲进房间，看到你和一群穿变装服的女孩在一起，害你被开除。

lines.en: : I’m sure that if I was ever going to get fired from this[school], it would have happened by now.
lines.zh: : 我要是真会因为这种事被这[school]开除，早该开除了。

: What? Shouldn’t you be excited about winning?
lines.zh: : 怎么？赢了不该开心吗？

lines.en: : I didn’t {i}want{/i} to win. I didn’t even want to be involved in this contest.
lines.zh: : 我不{i}想{/i}赢。我压根就不想参加这个比赛。

lines.en: : I just wanted to wear a costume of a character I liked without the fear of being ogled at or judged for doing so.
lines.zh: : 我只是想穿一套我喜欢的角色的衣服，不用害怕被人盯着看或者评头论足。

lines.en: : All picking me is going to do is upset literally everyone else.
lines.zh: : 选我只会让其他所有人都不高兴。

lines.en: : Thank you for voting for me or whatever, but I really wish you would have just picked someone else...

lines.zh: : 我支持选Futaba。我觉得她也很好看。

lines.en: : Are you sure you don’t want to...pick again maybe? It’s not too late to...vote for who you really want.
lines.zh: : 你确定不想……再选一次吗？现在……改投你真正想投的人还来得及。

lines.en: : I already did.
lines.zh: : 我已经选了。

lines.en: : I’ve told you time and time again that you’re cute. Consider this just one more step in me confirming that.
lines.zh: : 我跟你说过一遍又一遍你很可爱。就当这是我再一次确认这件事吧。

lines.en: scene secondhalloweenintro39
: Okay...
lines.zh: : 好吧……

lines.en: : Even if it’s just a little contest...having you choose me like this...really makes me happy...
lines.zh: : 就算只是个小比赛……被你这样选出来……我真的好开心……

lines.en: $ futaba_love += 5
{i}Futaba’s affection has increased to [futaba_love]!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Futaba 的好感度提升到了 [futaba_love]!{/i}

lines.en: $ futabahalloween2win = True
Molly
lines.zh: Molly

lines.en: : Well, after careful, internal deliberation...the winner of this contest is Molly.
lines.zh: : 嗯，经过审慎的内心权衡……这次比赛的赢家是Molly。

lines.en: scene secondhalloweenintro40
: Do...do my ears deceive me?!
lines.zh: : 我……我的耳朵没听错吧？！

lines.en: : I did spend an absurd amount of money on this costume, but I still would have wagered that you’d pick someone else, Sir!
lines.zh: : 我确实在这套衣服上花了离谱的一大笔钱，但我还是会赌您选别人，先生！

lines.en: : Maybe in some other timeline, I would have. But I think you look the “best” and, since I can only choose one...I guess it had to be you.
lines.zh: : 也许在别的世界线里我会选别人。但我觉得你看起来“最好”，而且既然我只能选一个……那大概就只能是你了。

lines.en: : Really? Even though I annoy you?
lines.zh: : 真的吗？哪怕我很烦人？

lines.en: : Even though we had a lengthy discussion recently about how I’ve all but given up on real human beings and that I will forever devote myself to dating games?
lines.zh: : 哪怕我们最近长谈过一次，我说我已经基本放弃了真实的人类，要终身献给恋爱游戏？

lines.en: : You’re still going to choose me after all of those flags have already been raised?
lines.zh: : 在这么多 flag 都已经立起来的情况下，您还是要选我？

lines.en: scene secondhalloweenintro41
: I guess so.
lines.zh: : 我想是的。

lines.en: : Congratulations, Molly. You deserve it.
lines.zh: : 恭喜你，Molly。这是你应得的。

lines.en: : Th...Thank you, Sir!
lines.zh: : 谢……谢谢您，先生！

lines.en: : As previously mentioned in your warning about this choice...I will not forget this!
lines.zh: : 正如您之前关于这个选择的警告里提到的……我不会忘记这件事的！

lines.en: $ molly_love += 5
{i}Molly’s affection has increased to [molly_love]!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Molly 的好感度提升到了 [molly_love]!{/i}

lines.en: $ mollyhalloween2win = True
Sana
lines.zh: Sana

lines.en: : The winner of this contest is...
lines.zh: : 这次比赛的赢家是……

lines.en: scene secondhalloweenintro42
: Sana.
lines.zh: : Sana。

lines.en: scene secondhalloweenintro43
: What?!
lines.zh: : 什么？！

lines.en: if sanafashion == False:
: You heard me, official Halloween costume winner.
lines.zh: : 你听到了，万圣节变装赛的正式冠军。

lines.en: else:
: You heard me, two time fashion contest champion.
lines.zh: : 你听到了，两届时装赛冠军。

lines.en: : I wasn’t even competing in this one!
lines.zh: : 我根本没参加这次啊！

lines.en: : Actually, Sana...you formally entered the competition when you stepped into the spotlight.
lines.zh: : 可是Sana……你踏进聚光灯的那一刻，就已经正式参加比赛了。

lines.en: : If you didn’t want to participate, you should have been more careful.
lines.zh: : 要是你不想参加，就该更小心一点。

lines.en: : Congratulations, Sana! I would have picked you too.
lines.zh: : 恭喜你，Sana！换我也会选你的。

lines.en: : I didn’t want to be picked! I don’t even have a costume yet!
lines.zh: : 我根本不想被选上！我连变装服都还没有！

lines.en: : You don’t need one. That’s how cute you are.
lines.zh: : 你不需要。你这样就够可爱了。

lines.en: : Ugh...Sana being in this contest made it unfair to the rest of us...
lines.zh: : 呃……Sana参加这个比赛，对我们其他人就不公平了……

lines.en: scene secondhalloweenintro44
: I wasn’t in the contest! This is all a big misunderstanding!
lines.zh: : 我没参加比赛！这全都是误会！

lines.en: $ sana_love += 5
{i}Sana’s affection has increased to [sana_love]!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Sana 的好感度提升到了 [sana_love]!{/i}

lines.en: $ sanahalloween2win = True
scene black
After I name the winner, it becomes clear that it’s time for all of the girls to start getting ready for tonight’s party.
lines.zh: 在我宣布完赢家之后，显然女孩们也该开始为今晚的派对做准备了。

lines.en: Apparently, some of the others have already started heading over to the Amamiya mansion to help set things up.
lines.zh: 看来，有些人已经先去天宫宅邸帮忙布置了。

lines.en: And fortunately, I wasn’t forced to go along with Makoto and participate in that stage of the party this year, saving me a fair amount of energy to use on more important matters- like sex.
lines.zh: 幸运的是，今年我没被拽着跟Makoto一起去参与派对的那个阶段，省下不少精力，可以用在更重要的事情上——比如做爱。

lines.en: Hopefully.
lines.zh: 希望如此。

lines.en: But, if that winds up not being the case, at least I’ll be a little less exhausted when I wind up having to deal with a drunken Molly or...anything else along those lines.
lines.zh: 不过，就算事与愿违，至少等我不得不去应付一个喝醉的Molly、或者类似状况时，我还能少累一点。

lines.en: Regardless...I, too, begin to make my way out of[school] alongside everyone else.
lines.zh: 不管怎样……我也跟着大家一起走出[school]。

lines.en: But, just as I make it to the lockers, Sana approaches me for the second time today (A new all-time record) and asks me to accompany her to her mother’s bar and help bring over some decorations for the party.
lines.zh: 可就在我走到储物柜前时，Sana今天第二次（打破历史纪录）来找我了，请我陪她去她妈妈的酒吧，帮忙把派对要用的一部分装饰搬过来。

lines.en: And while this sounds {i}technically{/i} a little easier than the hours I spent setting things up with Makoto, I can’t help but be a little upset.
lines.zh: 虽然这听起来比我和Makoto一起布置的那几个小时，{i}技术上{/i}要轻松点，但我还是忍不住有点沮丧。

lines.en: My short-lived desire to spend the moments before a party I just found out about in silence has, unfortunately, come to an end.
lines.zh: 我那个小小的愿望——在一个我刚刚才知道的派对开始之前安静地待一会儿——不幸就此终结了。

lines.en: But...
lines.zh: 可是……

lines.en: On the bright side, at least things at Sara’s were rather...{i}lively{/i} last Halloween.
lines.zh: 往好的方面想，至少去年万圣节 Sara 那边还挺……{i}热闹{/i}的。

lines.en: If I’m going to be tagging along with Sana, I can at least hope for a repeat of that...
lines.zh: 既然要跟着Sana一起走，我至少可以期待再来一次……
